headline: Mixed Reactions to New National Day Measures: Analysts Say Construction and Tourism May Benefit, Dining and Retail May Suffer
summary: Analysts say construction, tourism and technology could benefit from measures announced by PM Lawrence Wong at the National Day Rally. Dining and retail may face negative impacts.
why: Government support measures shape demand and costs in sectors such as construction, tourism and retail, which feed into Singapore's growth outlook.
